content.short: Large neobank with personal and business accounts, FX, cards and crypto.
content.description: Revolut is one of the world's largest neobanks, serving tens of millions of personal and business customers across the UK, Europe, and beyond from a single app. It offers multi-currency accounts, low-cost foreign exchange, physical and virtual cards, savings 'Vaults', budgeting, stock and commodity investing, insurance, and business accounts with expense and payment tools. Revolut also has a substantial crypto offering, letting users buy, sell, and hold digital assets, withdraw crypto on-chain across networks like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana, and trade through its dedicated Revolut X exchange. Holding banking licences in several markets and continually adding financial products, Revolut positions itself as an all-in-one financial super app, competing with traditional banks and other challengers on breadth, pricing, and global reach.
